Markley

  • 1503 Washington Heights, Ann Arbor, MI, 48109
  • 734-764-1151
  • [email protected]

Markley students love having a dining hall where they live, especially during the winter months. This full-service dining hall lets you customize your own personal pan pizza, have your burger just the way you like it, and build your own toasted sandwich.

Learn more about Michigan Dining’s Halal, Kosher, and Ramadan options.

Menu offerings are subject to change; please check menu signage in the dining hall for the most up-to-date information.
